meaning: Friendly welcoming gesture to invite someone in or express hospitality.
hand_configuration: Both open palms facing upward, sweeping gently inward toward the chest with welcoming facial expression.
isl_grammar_structure: Social discourse opening / polite greeting marker (Topic-Comment lexical sign).
cultural_linguistic_notes: Widely used in public reception counters, hospitals, and educational sign discourse across India.

media.description: Both open palms sweeping toward chest in hospitality.

source: ISLRTC Supplementary Vocabulary - Conversational Social Signs
